This is the inventory screen, where you will pick items up off the ground and use them. You can equip (i.e. wear or ready) items like weapons and armor, and you can use items like potions and crystals.

Items you can pick up are in the On Ground area to the upper right. Click on an item to pick it up. You can only pick up items you are close to. (If you don't see the dagger there, move closer to it and bring up this window again.)
Once you pick up an item, click on your character's graphic to equip it.
Press the OK button to the lower right when you're done.
You can also use and drop items on the Inventory screen.

Some items, like lamps, potions, and food, can be used. Items that can be used have a little glowing sun button on them. Click on that button to use the item. Then you will drink the potion, eat the food, etc.
To get rid of an item you don't want, click on it to pick it up. Then click on the On Ground area to set the item on the ground.
There are healing pods, lamps, and other useful items in the chambers around the Geneforge.
To get a full, detailed description of an item, hold down the Control key and click on it.
If there is a sort of weapon or item you use a lot (like healing pods or a favorite sword), you can put it in a Quick Use item slot and use it from the main playing screen.

To put an item in a Quick Use slot, click on it to pick it up, and then click on one of the four Quick Use slots. You can only put usable items (like potions, scrolls, and crystals) or weapons (like swords or javelins) in the Quick Use slots.
Then, on the main play screen, you will see the item on one of the four Quick Use buttons on the bottom of the screen. Click on that item to use/equip it.
When you have a Runestone, you can combine it with one of your weapons or pieces of armor to make a stronger item.
To combine a Runestone and an item, drop them in the Forge area (to the lower right) and press the Combine button. If the items in the forge can be combined, you will receive a new item.
You can only enhance any weapon or piece of armor once.
